# I'm Not the Nanny

> A biracial parenting and lifestyle blog by Thien-Kim Lam featuring Vietnamese-inspired recipes, family activities, and commentary on multiracial identity and parenting.

Thien-Kim Lam is a DC Metro-based blogger and media personality who has appeared on NBC News, NPR, BBC, and in the Washington Post. The site blends personal essays on biracial parenting with accessible family recipes and lifestyle content.
